firstAttempt.reason: Course component harness included global CSS ViewTransition navigation opt-in while omitting the global shell/UX controller; Chromium emitted four native aborted-transition errors after otherwise successful journeys.
firstAttempt.correction: Disable the global cross-document transition opt-in within this isolated component harness and wait for the exact question position. Keep all application pageerror assertions.
